name: Witch’s Bound
source:
Magic lives in the corners of our world, hidden from ordinary eyes.   

Behind every friendly face, there could be something entirely different, and dreams are not always just dreams.  

All Yuna wanted was a normal life, to blend in with the crowd and forget who she was.

But her new housemate and an unexpected friend will disrupt her fragile balance.

[From [url=https://purple-sugar.itch.io/witchs-bound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
魔法存在于我们世界的角落，隐藏在普通人的视线之外。

每一张友善的面孔背后，都可能隐藏着完全不同的东西，而梦想并不总是只是梦想。

尤娜想要的只是正常的生活，融入人群，忘记自己是谁。

但她的新室友和一位意想不到的朋友将打破她脆弱的平衡。

[来自[url=https://purple-sugar.itch.io/witchs-bound]itch.io[/url]]
